description: This file defines the Enforcement interface, which provides methods for retrieving enforcement input and filters, along with JSON serialization capabilities. The interface is part of the org.eclipse.ditto.model.connectivity package and references several JSON-related classes and annotations.

classes.name: Enforcement
classes.description: An interface representing enforcement data with methods to access input and filters, and to serialize to JSON.

classes.name: Enforcement.JsonFields
classes.description: A nested class defining JSON field definitions for 'input' and 'filters' used in serialization of Enforcement objects.

methods.name: getInput
methods.description: Retrieves the string to match against filters, such as a Thing ID or source address.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Retrieves the set of filters which contain placeholders and are compared against the input.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the Enforcement object to a JsonObject, with an overload that considers schema version and field selector.

methods.name: toJson(final JsonSchemaVersion schemaVersion, final JsonFieldSelector fieldSelector)
methods.description: Serializes the Enforcement object to a JsonObject according to specified schema version and field selection.
